proposed_fix: PROPOSAL: fix the 31 sites to their nearest fw-* equivalent; add a Section 8.4 ast-grep ratchet scoped to src/components/fairway/** forbidding the canonical radius names and rounded-[...] literals.

confidence: source-confirmed; no current call site combines asChild+disabled (grep-verified)
user_consequence: A Button rendered asChild (wrapping a Next Link, 20+ call sites) gets no haptic confirmation, cannot show a busy spinner, and cannot be disabled via the component's own prop; a future consumer passing busy/disabled to an asChild Button silently gets none of that behavior. Separately, all button press-down settles over 180ms, not the sub-100ms tactile snap Section 8.3 proposes.
expected: Section 8.3 flags the asChild/button feedback-path gap and proposes 0-60ms press settling.
actual: handleClick only fires fwHaptic when NOT asChild; content only renders the busy spinner in the non-asChild branch; the prop spread at line 198 means disabled/busy/type are never applied when asChild=true. fwPress only overrides the active-state easing curve, not the shared 180ms transition-duration.
mechanism: asChild forwards styling onto the Slot child but the component's busy/disabled/haptic logic is gated on the non-asChild branch only.
proposed_fix: PROPOSAL: type-restrict busy/disabled away from asChild consumers (compile error instead of silent no-op); add a dedicated ~60ms --fw-dur-press applied only on :active, separate from the shared 180ms base.
accessibility_check: An asChild Button a future consumer marks disabled would remain a fully operable, focusable link with no semantic indication of disablement.

user_consequence: A stacking-order bug (a popover/menu behind a modal it opened from, or a toast behind a nav bar) is one z-index-utility typo away at ~20+ files using either ladder's same-named class; the escape pattern already used twice is itself an unofficial third tier not written down anywhere.
expected: One reconciled z-index vocabulary with ratcheted enforcement (Section 8.1/8.4).
actual: tokens.css defines --z-overlay:20/--z-modal:30/--z-toast:40; design-tokens.css defines a different ladder, --fw-z-modal:50/--fw-z-toast:60. date-picker.tsx documents a real, previously-fixed collision (a popover at z-modal:30 rendered behind a ModalShell painting at --fw-z-modal:50), fixed by escaping to a third, undocumented z-dropdown:1000 value also used by Select.
mechanism: Two CSS custom-property ladders were introduced independently and never unified; both are exposed as same-named Tailwind utilities/arbitrary values.
proposed_fix: PROPOSAL: pick the design-tokens.css --fw-z-* ladder as canonical, formally name z-dropdown's 1000 value as a tier in it, delete the tokens.css ladder, sweep ~20 files onto the survivor, add a ratchet forbidding new z-[0-9] literals.
accessibility_check: A hidden-behind-modal popover can trap keyboard focus somewhere invisible.
